linkedin_text.title: Why we built FJA differently
linkedin_text.text:
Most job sites are built around the people posting jobs. We wanted one built around the person looking.

A few rules shaped Fortune Jobs AI:

1. Show what a job needs and what your résumé already covers, before you apply.
2. Keep the ATS score and its fixes free. No paywall on the useful part.
3. Let people search in plain English instead of guessing keywords.
4. Show where every listing comes from and when it was posted, and remove closed jobs daily.

Over the next few weeks we'll share these differences one at a time.

Try it free: https://fortunejobsai.com/?utm\_source=linkedin&utm\_medium=social

\#jobsearch \#careeradvice

linkedin_text.title: What's broken about job searching
linkedin_text.text:
Job searching has a few problems almost everyone recognizes:

→ The same job shows up five times on five sites.
→ Postings that closed weeks ago still look open.
→ Résumé feedback costs money before it tells you anything.
→ International students read every posting hunting for one line about sponsorship.

What Fortune Jobs AI does about each:

→ Live Search merges partner job networks with our catalogue and removes duplicates.
→ Every listing shows its source and posting date, and closed jobs are removed daily.
→ The ATS readiness score and line-by-line fixes are free.
→ A work-authorization filter finds postings that mention sponsorship or OPT. Always confirm with the employer.

Try it free: https://fortunejobsai.com/?utm\_source=linkedin&utm\_medium=social
